items.title: Fred Moore Interview, 1959-06-19
items.q: Well, I've done something with Jelly, Jelly at old Martin. How about? Oh, about two months.

ctx.x: Could you use your wood blocks, for example? Oh yeah, your wood blocks.

You could use wood blocks. Yeah, your wood blocks. And your car bell. You work with Jelly too? Well, I've done something with Jelly, Jelly at old Martin. How about? Oh, about two months. He had his, had about four or five automobiles, Cadillacs. Lincoln. Lincoln, yeah. So he diamonds? Yeah. He's playing all through Redding, Pennsylvania, and Philadelphia. Next time. Yeah. That's great. Yeah. He's playing them one night stands, you know. Sometimes the cars, one or two of the cars would break down. One or two of…
Jelly roll, did a lot of talking, lecturing. Yeah.
